title: Primary-only runtime preview reader-field audit
reviewScope: The current preview report has 269 decision rows and 136 selected primary-only additions; 204 was the earlier pre-hold count and is not the current selection. All 136 selected profiles were read for reader fields. A keyword screen found 13 possible metadata/secondary signals in 10 profiles; each was checked against the relevant fixed WEB context. All 13 reviewed statements were supported by primary text or are primary-grounded distinctions; none required a secondary article to support the factual clause. This is a bounded reader-field audit, not approval of all profile content or of non-selected rows. The five specifically corrected profiles are held in the current preview and therefore are not counted among selected additions.

specificPrimaryCorrections.fixedWEB: 1CH 7:20–27 places this genealogy under the sons of Ephraim; 7:27 names Nun and Joshua.
specificPrimaryCorrections.repair: The previous summary incorrectly said Benjamin; now says Ephraim.

specificPrimaryCorrections.fixedWEB: 1CH 27:16 calls Shephatiah “the son of Maacah”; it does not state Maacah’s gender.
specificPrimaryCorrections.repair: Changed mother to gender-neutral parent wording; article’s father claim remains explicitly secondary.

specificPrimaryCorrections.fixedWEB: 1CH 6:14 names Jehozadak as Seraiah’s son; captivity is first stated at 6:15.
specificPrimaryCorrections.repair: Removed captivity from always-visible subtitle/role; kept the gated 6:15 fact.

specificPrimaryCorrections.fixedWEB: 1CH 5:11 identifies the surrounding genealogical block as Gad; 5:14 places Gilead in Abihail’s ancestry.
specificPrimaryCorrections.repair: Changed Reuben to Gad in subtitle/summary.

specificPrimaryCorrections.fixedWEB: 1CH 4:2: “Reaiah the son of Shobal” then Jahath, father of Ahumai and Lahad.
specificPrimaryCorrections.repair: Corrected reversed Reaiah/Shobal order in summary.

readerFieldReviewConclusionJa: 現在のbuilder reportでは136件が選定対象（204件は保留追加前の旧件数）。二次資料依存を疑う語句を含む13欄を固定WEBと同書内文脈で確認した結果、事実部分は一次本文で支えられていた。記事にしか根拠がない読者欄はこの抽出範囲では見つからなかった。これは全プロフィールの独立承認ではなく、対象外/保留の承認を意味しない。
